decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The development shall be used only for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the single family house at No. 20 Woodstock Road.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for spa pool purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
Condition : 5 - No windows or other glazed openings shall be installed in the eastern elevation of the building facing N0 13a priory Avenue
description: Erection of single storey swimming enclosure building in rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
